title: Machine Learning Practicing
description: Explore supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, data preparation, model evaluation, decision trees, Naive Bayes, ensembles, and random forests. This course has already been selected.

title: Identification, Estimation and Learning
description: Study system identification and estimation, including least squares, Kalman filters, neural networks, model selection, experiment design, and validation.

title: Vehicle Networking and Internet of Things
description: Learn vehicle communication networks and protocols such as CAN, LIN, Ethernet, TCP/IP, and GPS based positioning.
formLabel: CSE 479 — Vehicle Networking and Internet of Things

title: Digital Circuit Design
description: Design digital circuits with VHDL, from modeling and simulation through synthesis and implementation on FPGAs.

title: Microcontroller Engineering-2
description: Program ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers and explore processor architectures, interrupts, memory-mapped peripherals, embedded C, and software structures.

title: Building Management Systems
description: Explore building management systems for HVAC, lighting, fire, and security, including sensors, controls, SCADA, energy management, and occupancy applications.

title: Power Plant Systems and Control
description: Study power plant components and instrumentation, boiler and turbine control, steam systems, safety, load management, and combined-cycle operation.
formLabel: EEP 326 - Power Plant Systems and Control

title: Industrial Automation 2
description: Work with distributed control systems, PLCs, industrial networks, HMI and SCADA, safety systems, smart devices, and closed-loop process control.

title: Power Electronics and Electric Drives-2
description: Study switching converters, MOSFET and IGBT gate driving, DC motor drives, braking, V/f control, and vector and direct-torque control. This course has already been selected.

title: Finite Element Analysis
description: Build finite element models for structural and coupled problems, program 2D elements, explore nonlinear analysis, and use commercial tools for meshing and results.

title: Engineering Optimization
description: Formulate and solve engineering design optimization problems using graphical, numerical, gradient-based, constrained, and linear programming methods.

title: HVAC Systems and Control
description: Design and control HVAC systems, including air handlers, VAV, chilled and hot water sequencing, air distribution, fans, pumps, boilers, chillers, and direct digital control.

title: Micro- Heat Exchanger Design
description: Design micro-channel heat exchangers and compare their thermal performance and pressure drop with conventional exchangers, including electronics cooling applications.

title: Industrial Mechanisms
description: Explore automated assembly, transfer and indexing systems, vibratory feeders, part orientation and handling, gripping mechanisms, and biomimetic mechanisms.

title: Design of Mechatronic Systems-2
description: Model complex mechatronic systems and design control strategies for vehicles and robots, including online optimization and a team design project.

title: Smart Materials and Structures
description: Study smart material fabrication, modeling, and design, including piezoelectrics, shape-memory alloys, electroactive polymers, and fiber optics.

title: Industrial Process Control
description: Develop industrial process-control strategies using feedback, feedforward, model predictive, and supervisory control, with instrumentation, safety, testing, and case studies.

title: Motion Planning
description: Plan motions for robot arms, mobile and multi-robot systems, including non-holonomic and high-dimensional planning, with algorithm implementation and a project.

title: Introduction to Biotronics Systems
description: Combine biological signals and sensors with mechatronics, human-robot interaction, and medical robotics such as image-guided surgery and rehabilitation.

title: CNC Machines
description: Learn CNC machine axes, milling and turning, tool paths, cutting motion, and program preparation using G-codes and M-codes.

title: Biomechanics and Robotics
description: Connect biomechanics and robotics across prosthetics, rehabilitation, human-robot interaction, sports, robot-aided surgery, and human movement analysis.

title: Rehabilitation Robotics
description: Explore rehabilitation robots and interfaces, then design and control prostheses, exoskeletons, wheelchairs, and other assistive systems.

title: Mobile Robot
description: Study mobile robot kinematics, sensing, control, navigation, multi-target tracking, obstacle mapping, and robot manipulation.

title: Micro robotics
description: Examine microrobot design, scaling and adhesion, electrostatic, thermal, shape-memory and piezoelectric actuators, and optical and electromagnetic sensing.

title: Vehicle Dynamics and Control
description: Model vehicle lateral, longitudinal, and ride dynamics; study active safety, suspension, drive-by-wire, adaptive cruise control, and lane keeping.

title: Autonomous Vehicles
description: Use probabilistic estimation and decision-making for autonomous robots, including mapping, localization, planning, control, cooperation, and marine, ground, and air vehicles.

title: Vehicle Safety and Control
description: Study integrated vehicle safety from warnings and collision avoidance through braking, stability control, airbags, restraint systems, and post-event response.

title: Introduction to Autotronics Systems
description: Survey vehicle systems including starting, fuel, ignition, transmission, steering, suspension, braking, HVAC, electric and hybrid vehicles, sensors, and actuators.
